svg.text: 数据模型实体关系图（ER Diagram）
HouseStatus: VACANT(空置), RESERVED(预约), ORDERED(已订), SIGNED(已签), TERMINATED(已终止)
OrderStatus: PENDING_REVIEW(待审核), APPROVED(已通过), REJECTED(已拒绝), CANCELLED(已取消)
ContractStatus: WAIT_TENANT_SIGN(待签字), WAIT_STAMP(待盖章), PENDING_PAYMENT(待支付), ACTIVE(生效), VOID(作废), TERMINATED(已终止)
BillStatus: UNPAID(未支付), PAID(已支付), OVERDUE(已逾期) | BillKind: BASE(基础), ADJUSTMENT(补缴)
AdminRoleCode: SYSTEM_ADMIN(系统管理员), STORE_MANAGER(店长)
